user.title: Welcome
user.description:
Healix watches important Home Assistant entities, diagnoses failures, and safely recovers only the affected config entry when policy allows.

Dry run is enabled by default so you can see what Healix would do before allowing recovery.

mode.description: Choose how Healix should behave after setup.

safety.title: Safety settings
safety.description: Keep the defaults unless you already know you need different timing.

init.title: Healix options
init.description: Advanced settings are hidden unless enabled.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description:
Comma-separated values. Labels still override these defaults.

For network health entities, add router or internet ping binary sensors. If left empty, Healix shows not_configured as setup guidance, not as a fault.

retry_limit_reached.title: Healix stopped auto-recovery for {integration}
retry_limit_reached.description: Healix reached a retry limit for {integration}. Reason: {reason}. Check the device, network, credentials, or integration logs before trying again.

failed_setup.title: Healix detected setup failure for {integration}
failed_setup.description: {integration} is in a Home Assistant setup failure or retry state. Healix will not repeatedly reload it while Home Assistant is already retrying.
